rows.grounds: mantra phrase agna āyā iti with mantreṇa; treated as a single token
qualifies the western archway in context

items.question: Which mantra governs the installation of the western archway?
premises: The eastern archway is installed with the agnimīḷiti mantra.
The western archway requires its own specified mantra.
The mantra agna āyā iti is prescribed for this act.
items.inference: Therefore the western archway is to be installed with the agna āyā iti mantra.
uncertainties: The gender of paścimasya is inferred from context as referring to the archway.
items.plain_english: The installation of the western archway is to be done with the mantra 'agna āyā iti'.
